'''Security Hub 771''' was a security station located at the [[Power Junction 353]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 10" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] wired an [[Ion grenade/Legends|Ion grenade]] into the Junction and disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="KotFE 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security Hub 771 appears on Zakuul during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 10" />
